plainText:
----
 

The Crystal Onix (Japanese: クリスタルのイワーク Crystal Iwark) is a special with a body made out of glass crystal.

==History==
The Crystal Onix appeared in The Crystal Onix episode. and first heard of it through a note they found in a bottle floating in the ocean. The note was written by a little girl named Marissa. She wanted to find the Crystal Onix to help her brother, , gain inspiration to make glass statues. Mateo told a story of how his grandfather discovered the Crystal Onix and then was able to make extraordinary sculptures afterwards. One of those sculptures included the Crystal Onix itself.

With the help of , was able to assist greatly in finding the Crystal Onix's hideout.

Besides being made of crystal, the Crystal Onix is also unique from other Onix in that it can live in water without being hurt by it. Its glass skin also gives it a special resistance to attacks. Mateo realized that he would have to use a different type of attack to weaken it and so, he used his and attacked it with . It seemed to have a weakness to attacks, unlike other Onix. Mateo was just about to capture it when he realized that he didn't need to. Just battling it gave him the inspiration he needed to create perfect glass Pokémon sculptures. He thanked the Crystal Onix as it submerged itself into the water once more.

==Personality and characteristics==
Due to its brief appearance and screentime, not much is known of the Crystal Onix's personality. Unlike other Onix, it doesn't hate water and was, in fact, first seen swimming in a pool.

==Moves used==
 
 
 
 

==Trivia==
The Crystal Onix bears some resemblance with Pokémon affected by the Terastal phenomenon, which was introduced in and also involves the affected Pokémon being covered in crystals and potentially changing their type weaknesses and strengths.

==Related articles==
